categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Tests' label and modifies benchmark framework code in src/bench/ to replace a static block fixture with a synthetic block generator.
categories.rationale: Improves benchmark realism and coverage by replacing a 2016 pre-SegWit block fixture with configurable blocks that exercise modern SegWit and Taproot scripts. As reviewers noted, benchmarking solely against a pre-SegWit block left post-2016 transaction and script paths unmeasured in block benchmarks.
